name: Complete geometric-progression Erdős–Straus classification
statement: All positive ordered GP-denominator solutions are uniquely x=tD*a^2, y=tD*ab, z=tD*b^2, n=4t*a^2*b^2 for coprime 0<a<b, t>=1, D=a^2+ab+b^2; no primitive denominator triple exists.
scope_note: Classifies the geometric-progression-denominator subfamily only; does not prove the full Erdős–Straus conjecture.
